definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that looks impressive, attractive, or admirably stylish.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}、かっこいい。
かっこいい{車|くるま}に{乗|の}りたい。
examples.english: I want to drive a cool car.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{生|い}き{方|かた}はかっこいいと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think the way he lives is admirable.

notes:
かっこいい (also written as {格好|かっこう}いい) is a very common casual expression for praising appearance or style. It can describe:
- Physical attractiveness (especially men)
- Stylish items (cars, clothes, etc.)
- Admirable behavior or attitudes

Contrast:
- かっこいい: cool, stylish (general/masculine)
- かわいい: cute (general/feminine)
- かっこ{悪|わる}い: uncool, embarrassing

Note: While historically more commonly used for men, かっこいい is increasingly used for women as well, especially for describing a "cool" aesthetic.
